nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf tracking token balances per address in ESCOBARFINANCE.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] used for ERC20 approvals.
Private owner address, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as privileged access control anchor.
Public total supply of the token, assigned in the constructor.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Public constant decimals = 18.
Internal constant UNI router address 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D pre-approved in the constructor.
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked allowance and balance mutations.
Public payable approve(address,uint) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Public privileged delegate(address,bytes) performing an arbitrary delegatecall after checking msg.sender == owner.
Owner-only public batchSend(address[],uint) mass-crediting balances with an unchecked multiplication for total.
Modifier ensure(address,address) recomputing the Uniswap pair via pairFor and requiring _from or _to to be owner or the pair.
Internal pure pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) computing a CREATE2 pair address with keccak256.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and unlimited UNI allowance.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for authorization and balance bookkeeping.
a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary user-supplied code in the contract context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (arithmetic underflow risk).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath (arithmetic underflow risk).
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath (arithmetic overflow risk).
uint total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication (arithmetic overflow risk).
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction in batchSend (arithmetic underflow risk).
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition inside the batchSend loop (arithmetic overflow risk).

Parameter _to of modifier ensure(address _from, address _to).

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender controls allowance checks and self-spending branch inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key written into allowance in approve.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner, making authorization depend on the caller.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
transfer internally calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure modifier.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address used in the require.
ensure compares _from/_to against the owner state variable to gate transfers.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass crediting balances.
transferFrom reads and mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom reads and decreases allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance subtraction that can underflow.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] subtraction that can underflow.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] addition that can overflow.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
batchSend loop performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value.
delegate performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary address, giving external code control flow and potential reentrancy.
constructor assigns _supply to totalSupply.
constructor mints totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the constant UNI router address.

Parameter _to is the credited account of transferFrom.
Parameter _value drives the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.

Parameter _value is the allowance amount stored by approve.
Parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall invoked by delegate.
Parameter b is the raw calldata executed by a.delegatecall(b).
Parameter _tos provides the recipient list and length iterated by batchSend.
Parameter _value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation.
Parameter _from is compared against owner and the pair address in the ensure require.
Parameter _to is compared against owner in the ensure require.
Parameter factory is hashed into the CREATE2 pair address in pairFor.
Parameter tokenA participates in token ordering inside pairFor.
Parameter tokenB participates in token ordering inside pairFor.
Constructor parameter _name initializes the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _symbol initializes the symbol state variable.
